map.毛利率 = (收入 − 成本)/收入；营业利润 = 毛利润 − 期间费用（销售: Gross margin = (revenue − cost)/revenue; operating profit = gross profit − period expenses (selling + admin + R&D) − depreciation & amortization; EBITDA = operating profit + depreciation & amortization; net profit = operating profit − finance expense − income tax; net margin = net profit/revenue; DuPont: ROE = net margin × total asset turnover × equity multiplier
